IntegrationsIntegrations
Browse our growing marketplace of trusted partners and find integrations to streamline your workflows, enhance productivity, and unlock new possibilities.
Smart Roofing AI
Smart Roofing AI gives your roofing company a brain that tracks every job and knows what's next. Request Hover captures or import existing jobs, and measurements flow straight into your estimates automatically.Learn more
Cloudflow
CloudFlow is a modern AI-powered CRM that helps roofing contractors maximize jobs won while minimizing software needed to run their business.Learn more
Zoho CRM
Intelligent automation meets intuitive design. Built with AI at its core, Zoho CRM supercharges your business to get ahead without the overhead.Learn more
Zoho Flow
Trigger workflows based on activity in Hover, send Hover data to third-party applications, Automate updates across CRM, project management, accounting, or communication tools, reduce manual data entry and improve operational efficiency.Learn more
Zuper
Import measurements and all other Hover project data directly into Zuper; enabling you to access everything you need, all in one place.Learn more
ContractorFlow
Streamline your workflow by automatically linking photos, measurements, and material lists from Hover to ContractorFlow. See faster estimates, fewer errors, and a smoother path from site to quote.Learn more
ServiceTitan
ServiceTitan is a cloud-based software platform built to power roofing & exteriors businesses. The company’s comprehensive solution gives contractors the tools they need to, maximize profit, optimize operations, and deliver trustworthy homeowner experiences. Learn more
Bolster
Bolster helps your construction business make more money. Estimate faster, win more jobs with automatic presentations, and let your customers make upgrades & selections from the first quote.Learn more
Scopeworx
Generate estimates in under a minute, using accurate property measurements and images, while keeping full control of your pricing and margins.Learn more
AccuLynx
AccuLynx was founded with the goal of helping roofing and exterior contractors succeed. Their software is designed to accommodate the unique needs and workflows of roofing.Learn more
Salesforce unlocked package
The Hover for Salesforce (Unlocked) integration is an open-source package that allows users to seamlessly connect their Salesforce instance with Hover.Learn more
JobTread
JobTread empowers you with simple yet powerful project management and construction estimating software to help you tackle projects more efficiently. Get organized, complete your projects on time, and increase your profits.Learn more
Leap™ CRM
Leap™ CRM streamlines every step of the job with powerful lead management, seamless workflow customization, advanced data reporting, best-in-class integrations and more.Learn more
Leap™ SalesPro
Leap™ SalesPro drives the entire sales process from start to finish, automating accurate estimates, dynamic contract linking, pricing control, and more.Learn more
CompanyCam
CompanyCam helps contractors build trust with their crews and customers through photo documentation. They make it easy to keep everyone on the same page.Learn more
JobNimbus
JobNimbus is a CRM software company developed with the help of leading industry experts to give contractors a better tool for managing their businesses.Learn more
SumoQuote
Perfect every part of your sales experience. Create winning quotes in minutes that accelerate your company’s growth.Learn more
Zapier
Zapier lets you connect Hover with thousands of the most popular apps, so you can automate your work and have more time for what matters most—no code required.Learn more
Xactimate®
Streamline your claims process and generate precise, professional estimates for restoration jobs of all types. Xactimate® makes estimating property claims more efficient.Learn more
XactAnalysis®
XactAnalysis® monitors your claims data to help catch errors, report on progress, and benchmark performance to reduce claims costs and increase the precision and speed of settlements.Learn more
XactRemodel
Designed with contractors in mind. XactRemodel® is the one tool you need to simplify and establish a more efficient workflow. Learn more
Claims Workspace™
Access a centralized, holistic view of all your ongoing claims projects, from inception to resolution.Learn more
Claims Estimate™
Efficiently document damage and automatically create accurate estimates for every property claim with cotality's estimating software.Learn more
Claims Validate™
Automate claims quality assurance by running claim estimates against insurance carrier company guidelines and rule sets to drive accuracy and efficiency.Learn more
Underwriting Center™
Cotality’s property and risk datasets and AI-enabled workflows are revolutionizing residential property inspections and optimizing underwriter efficiency.Learn more
FileTrac
Interlinking people, processes, and advanced technology in the insurance space.Learn more
Sketchup
Shape the future with intuitive, professional 3D design software that helps you visualize, communicate, and realize your ideas.Learn more
Builder Prime
Builder Prime is an all-in-one business management solution custom-built for home improvement companies.Learn more
Followup CRM
Streamline projects, foster client relationships, and supercharge efficiency. Built for construction professionals, by industry experts. Learn more
One Click Contractor
A simplified sales and estimating software solution that enables remodeling contractors to be more efficient and accurate while accelerating growth.Learn more
RoofLink
Automate and streamline your roofing business with software built by professional roofers for professional roofers. Learn more
Restoration AI
Roof artificial intelligence that assists the contractor with estimating properly and supplementing insurance claims.Learn more
Paradigm Vendo™
A digital selling solution that lets contractors and in-home sales professionals streamline selling – from appointment scheduling to signed contract. Learn more
QMax™
Job management software for the construction specialty trade industry that works the way you do. Roofing, siding, windows, gutters, solar, and more!Learn more
ProLine
Simple software for roofers who want to dominate their market and still make it home for dinner.Learn more
Roof Hub (measurements)
Roof Hub was built for roofing contractors. Get a new project underway or order more materials for an existing job.Learn more
Roof Hub (ordering)
Simplify your projects with live pricing, real-time delivery tracking, and the best-in-class tools to grow your business.Learn moreABCSupply-tileLearn more
myABCsupply
Conﬁrm order details and check the status of upcoming deliveries to keep your team on track. Manage your account, view statements, pay invoices, and ﬁnd an ABC location near you.Learn more
QXO
Customize your Material List template with QXO products (formerly Beacon), and place material orders all within the Hover platform.Learn more
Belgard
From inspiration to installation, Belgard is here to help make the outdoor space of your dreams a reality. Learn more
